width.zh-CN: 图片显示宽度，数值按 px 处理。
width.en-US: Display width of the image; a number is in px.

height.zh-CN: 图片显示高度，数值按 px 处理。
height.en-US: Display height of the image; a number is in px.

alt.zh-CN: 图像描述，同时作为可预览缩略图的读屏名称。
alt.en-US: Image description, also the accessible name of a previewable thumbnail.

crossOrigin.zh-CN: 透传给原生 img 标签的 crossorigin。
crossOrigin.en-US: The crossorigin attribute passed to the native img element.

fallback.zh-CN: 加载失败时显示的容错图片地址，或自定义内容的 snippet。
fallback.en-US: Fallback image URL shown when loading fails, or a snippet for custom content.

placeholder.zh-CN: 图片未加载成功时的占位内容的 snippet。
placeholder.en-US: Snippet for the placeholder content shown until the image has loaded.

preview.zh-CN: 预览配置，为 false 时禁用预览；对象只放数据与回调，自定义内容使用 Image 的 snippet。
preview.en-US: Preview options; false disables preview. The object carries data and callbacks only; use the Image snippets for custom content.

imgStyle.zh-CN: 自定义样式，透传给 img 节点。
imgStyle.en-US: Custom style passed to the img element.

imgCls.zh-CN: 自定义样式类名，透传给 img 节点。
imgCls.en-US: Custom class name passed to the img element.

setDownloadName.en-US: Sets the download file name of the image.

onLoad.en-US: Called when the image has loaded.

onError.en-US: Called when the image fails to load.

title.zh-CN: 替换预览顶部标题区的内容，有标题时对话框以 snippet 渲染出的文字命名；仅作用于该 Image 自己的预览，位于 ImagePreview 内时无效。
title.en-US: Replaces the content of the title section at the top of the preview; when there is a title, the dialog is named by the text the snippet renders. It applies to this Image's own preview only and has no effect inside an ImagePreview.

previewMenu.zh-CN: 自定义预览底部操作区；仅作用于该 Image 自己的预览，位于 ImagePreview 内时无效。
previewMenu.en-US: Custom bottom menu of the preview. It applies to this Image's own preview only and has no effect inside an ImagePreview.

leftIcon.zh-CN: 自定义向左切换图标；仅作用于该 Image 自己的预览，位于 ImagePreview 内时无效。
leftIcon.en-US: Custom previous icon. It applies to this Image's own preview only and has no effect inside an ImagePreview.

rightIcon.zh-CN: 自定义向右切换图标；仅作用于该 Image 自己的预览，位于 ImagePreview 内时无效。
rightIcon.en-US: Custom next icon. It applies to this Image's own preview only and has no effect inside an ImagePreview.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 自定义关闭图标；仅作用于该 Image 自己的预览，位于 ImagePreview 内时无效。
closeIcon.en-US: Custom close icon. It applies to this Image's own preview only and has no effect inside an ImagePreview.

src.zh-CN: 要预览的图片地址列表，决定组内图片及其顺序；包裹的 Image 按自己的 src（或 preview.src）在列表中的位置打开预览，不在列表中的 Image 单独预览。
src.en-US: Image URLs to preview; they define the images of the group and their order. A wrapped Image opens the preview at the position of its own src (or preview.src) in the list; an Image not in the list previews on its own.

visible.zh-CN: 是否预览，可 bind:visible；未绑定时由组件自行管理，初始关闭。
visible.en-US: Whether the preview is open; supports bind:visible. Unbound, the component manages it and starts closed.

currentIndex.zh-CN: 当前预览图片下标，可 bind:currentIndex；未绑定时由组件自行管理，初始为 0。
currentIndex.en-US: Index of the current image; supports bind:currentIndex. Unbound, the component manages it and starts at 0.

previewTitle.zh-CN: 预览顶部标题，同时作为预览对话框的读屏名称；titles 中当前图片的标题优先。
previewTitle.en-US: Title at the top of the preview and the accessible name of the dialog; the title of the current image in titles takes precedence.

titles.zh-CN: 与 src 逐项对应的预览标题数组。
titles.en-US: Preview titles, one per entry of src.

alts.zh-CN: 与 src 逐项对应的预览图片替代文本数组。
alts.en-US: Alternative texts of the preview images, one per entry of src.

lazyLoad.en-US: Whether to lazy-load the images of the group.

lazyLoadMargin.zh-CN: 懒加载的 rootMargin，相对视口计算；滚动祖先仍会裁剪。
lazyLoadMargin.en-US: The rootMargin of the lazy-load observer, relative to the viewport; scrolling ancestors still clip.

maskClosable.en-US: Whether clicking the mask closes the preview.

closable.en-US: Whether to show the close button.

closeOnEsc.zh-CN: 按 Esc 是否关闭预览。

showTooltip.zh-CN: 是否展示底部操作区提示。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether to show tooltips on the bottom controls.

preLoadGap.en-US: How many images ahead and behind to preload.

viewerVisibleDelay.zh-CN: 隐藏预览操作按钮前的无操作时长，单位毫秒。
viewerVisibleDelay.en-US: Idle time in milliseconds before the preview controls hide.

zoomStep.zh-CN: 每次缩小或放大的比例。

maxZoom.zh-CN: 预览图片最大缩放倍数。

minZoom.zh-CN: 预览图片最小缩放倍数。

initialZoom.zh-CN: 预览图片初始缩放倍数，仅在首次打开或切换到该图片时生效一次，会被 minZoom 与 maxZoom 限制。
initialZoom.en-US: Initial zoom factor of an image, applied once when it first opens or is switched to, clamped by minZoom and maxZoom.

crossOrigin.zh-CN: 透传给预览图片的原生 img 标签的 crossorigin。
crossOrigin.en-US: The crossorigin attribute passed to the preview img element.

previewCls.en-US: Custom class name of the preview.

adaptiveTip.zh-CN: 适应页面操作按钮提示。

originTip.zh-CN: 原始尺寸操作按钮提示。

getPopupContainer.zh-CN: 指定预览渲染的父级 DOM。容器不是 document.body 时预览为非模态，自定义容器需要 position: relative。
getPopupContainer.en-US: Parent DOM the preview renders into. A container other than document.body makes the preview non-modal; a custom container needs position: relative.

setDownloadName.en-US: Sets the download file name of an image.

children.zh-CN: 要预览的 Image 组件的 snippet。
children.en-US: Snippet for the Image components to preview.

title.zh-CN: 替换预览顶部标题区的内容的 snippet，参数为 `{ title, index }`。有标题时对话框经 aria-labelledby 以标题区命名，名称即 snippet 渲染出的文字；没有标题时名称来自语言包。
title.en-US: Snippet that replaces the content of the title section at the top of the preview, receiving `{ title, index }`. When there is a title, the dialog is named by that section through aria-labelledby, so its name is the text the snippet renders; without a title the name comes from the locale.

previewMenu.zh-CN: 自定义预览底部操作区的 snippet，参数为 MenuProps，menuItems 是默认各项的 snippet，渲染时一次输出全部默认项。
previewMenu.en-US: Snippet for the custom bottom menu, receiving MenuProps; menuItems is a snippet that renders all the default items at once.

leftIcon.zh-CN: 自定义向左切换图标的 snippet，参数为 `{ index }`。
leftIcon.en-US: Snippet for the custom previous icon, receiving `{ index }`.

rightIcon.zh-CN: 自定义向右切换图标的 snippet，参数为 `{ index }`。
rightIcon.en-US: Snippet for the custom next icon, receiving `{ index }`.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 自定义关闭图标的 snippet。
closeIcon.en-US: Snippet for the custom close icon.

onClose.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮或按 Esc 关闭时触发；点击遮罩关闭只触发 onVisibleChange。
onClose.en-US: Called when closed with the close button or Esc; closing by the mask triggers onVisibleChange only.

onZoomIn.en-US: Called when the image zooms in.

onZoomOut.en-US: Called when the image zooms out.

onPrev.en-US: Called when switching to the previous image.

onNext.en-US: Called when switching to the next image.

onRatioChange.zh-CN: 切换原始尺寸与适应页面时触发。
onRatioChange.en-US: Called when switching between original size and fit-to-page.

onRotateLeft.zh-CN: 逆时针旋转图片时触发。
onRotateLeft.en-US: Called when the image rotates counterclockwise.

onDownload.en-US: Called when an image is downloaded.
